name: Sendpository Free
free_limit: 6,000 sent emails/month (up to 200/day), 1 sending domain, 2 webhook endpoints, 3 receiving addresses and up to 300 received emails/day; full API and delivery logs.
watch_out: Free is an ongoing $0 plan for side projects; throughput is limited to 2 API requests/second and 200 outgoing emails/day. Higher volumes and scheduled sending require paid Pro. Payment-card and commercial-use requirements are not explicitly confirmed.
